newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai sets up Sino-German $29.8 mln piston jv.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai sets up Sino-German $29.8 mln piston jv.

text.p: Shanghai Automotive Co Ltd has signed a $29.8 million joint venture contract with two German companies to produce pistons for motor vehicle engines, the Business News said on Wednesday.
Germany's Kolbenschmidt AG would have a 35 percent stake in the new company, and DEG Deutsche Investitions 15 percent, the newspaper said.
The Chinese partner would hold 50 percent of the company, to be called Kolbenschmidt Shanghai Piston Co Ltd, it said.
The joint venture had registered capital of $22 million, it said.
The new company aimed at annual output of 4.5 million pistons by 2001 with turnover of $27 million, it said.
Export volume would be worth $3.9 million a year by then, accounting for 15 percent of the total, it said.
